audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Vayne levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 at 2/10 while the whys for those exact rows say 'even skill test', 'stays neutral', 'remains a skill trade' and 'roughly even'. Rows 3 and 5 were the mirror image — marked Skill while their whys say Vayne takes them.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Skill, Skill, Vayne, Skill, Vayne, Vayne] and every whys[] string matches that, not the shipped rows; Tryndamere also wins 52.65% over 1827 games, which cannot sit under a chart giving Vayne four early stages at 2/10.
audit.corrected: All seven rows aligned to the packet chart in both layers, ratings adjusted with them, and phases[5].why rewritten so the First-item row no longer claims Tryndamere's spike on a Vayne-sided stage.

audit.why: Spike placement is right: Vayne's real spike is her first crit item plus Final Hour (100/85/70s), Tryndamere's is levels 2-3 and his own first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn was described as a flat 'wall-stun' with no cooldown, the terrain condition was never stated as a positioning rule, and Tumble's auto-attack reset was absent everywhere.
audit.why: Riot kit: Condemn 20/18/16/14/12s, 550 range, knocks back and only stuns on terrain collision — in open lane it costs her 20s at rank 1 for a knockback. Tumble carries the autoReset flag on a 6/5/4/3/2s cooldown, so her burst opens with an attack wind-up, not a visible cast; that is the cue to step out.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d with the cooldowns, the terrain condition and the Tumble reset tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vayne is referred to as 'he'/'his' in six places (breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, report[2], report[4], report[12]).
audit.why: Wrong pronoun for the champion reads as boilerplate and undercuts trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in place; no other wording changed.
